paper.title: FARGO: Fast Maximum Inner Product Search via Global Multi-Probing

risks: The artifact is a small research repository with no detected package/environment manifest; dependency installation, licensing, and end-to-end dataset setup are not demonstrated.
The inspect-only probe identified source and a candidate command but did not execute the build or benchmarks, so practical portability remains uncertain.
Large-scale sweeps over recall-efficiency tradeoffs could exceed evaluation budgets unless dataset size, index construction, and query counts are tightly bounded.
Zero reported citations, influential citations, and GitHub stars provide little evidence of adoption or sustained community impact.
Optimization may overfit individual vector distributions unless the benchmark uses multiple hidden datasets, dimensions, and norm distributions.
